name: composition-review
description: "Use when presenting or revising a live Remotion or HyperFrames composition for review."
---

## Composition review

Voyager opens a Remotion or HyperFrames composition live in the Files pane so the user can play, scrub, and pin or draw notes on frames and elements.

- At every checkpoint, present the entry instead of rendering and end the turn: `voyager files present <piece>/motion/src/index.tsx --title "…" --deliverable none --json` (Remotion) or `<piece>/motion/index.html` (HyperFrames). Render the final video (`--deliverable <piece>`) only when approved or requested.
- Notes return with frame, pin or drawing, and target element. Edit the source, call `review_resolve` for each addressed note, and end the turn. Name notes by their time or words, never their id.
- When the user set a quality goal for this conversation (`goal_set`), a checkpoint does not end the turn: present the entry, render a draft or stills of it outside the deliverables for `goal_review`, and keep improving until the goal is met.
